name: Pool spec: Europe
description: The Europe spec for the Pool generator: concrete shell and pool water values from EN 1992-1-1, EN 1992-3, EN 206, EN 16582, EN 16713, EN 15288 and national rules where there is no European one. Every value names its standard, clause and whether it was read in the standard itself. Not a substitute for the standards or an engineer.
author: CadCraft
